objective: Generate exactly one composite 16:9 landscape studio image of one adult woman in three adjacent panels, with only the right portrait showing her face.

canvas.layout: A single image divided left to right into three panels, approximately 30%, 30%, and 40% width, with two thin solid #d1d1d2 vertical lines. All panels use the same solid #504f50 studio background. No margins, captions, labels, or separate images.

panels.subject: Full-length adult woman, relaxed standing pose, complete arms, hands, legs, and shoes. Her head and neck are entirely omitted: the sweatshirt crewneck is the topmost visible edge of this figure, with uninterrupted gray studio background immediately above it. No skin, neck stump, chin, hair, or face above the collar.
panels.wardrobe_visible: Fully opaque heavyweight cream cotton crewneck sweatshirt, straight dark indigo denim jeans, and plain white low-top canvas sneakers.

panels.subject: The same adult woman standing from behind, full length and uncropped. The back of her shoulder-length dark brown hair is visible; no face or profile.
panels.wardrobe_visible: Exact same cream sweatshirt, dark indigo straight jeans, and white sneakers; rear seams and hems align with the front.

panels.subject: Same adult woman, about 30 years old, fair neutral skin, oval face, straight dark eyebrows, brown eyes, medium straight nose, natural lips, shoulder-length dark brown hair parted near middle. Turn her head and shoulders 30 degrees toward viewer-left; one cheek and one ear are more visible than the other, with a clear three-quarter perspective, not a frontal passport pose. Neutral closed mouth; natural skin pores, subtle texture, small eye catch-lights. No hands or arms.
panels.wardrobe_visible: Exact same cream crewneck sweatshirt and neckline.

identity.source: Original fictional adult character with the fixed features described in the portrait.
identity.distinctive_features: No moles, tattoos, piercings, scars, or jewelry.

wardrobe.canonical_outfit: Heavyweight fully opaque cream cotton crewneck sweatshirt, straight dark indigo denim jeans, plain white low-top canvas sneakers; identical in all views.
wardrobe.product_modeling_zones: Bare ears, neck, wrists, and fingers.

background_and_lighting.background: Uniform solid #504f50 studio backdrop in all three panels.
background_and_lighting.light: Broad soft neutral frontal studio light around 5500K, balanced exposure, gentle shadows, no backlight through clothing.

camera_and_style.camera: Eye-level, normal lens, rectilinear studio reference photography; deep focus.
camera_and_style.detail: Photoreal skin, hair strands, fabric weave, seams, and drape, without beauty retouching or cinematic color grade.

consistency_locks: Exactly one output image, 16:9 landscape, with three adjacent panels and two #d1d1d2 separators.
The left front body is completely headless; center back body has no readable face; right portrait is the only face source.
All panels show the same person wearing the same outfit with matching fabric, cut, colors, and footwear.
negative_prompt: separate images, portrait canvas, extra panels, labels, watermarks
head or face on the front body, face on the back body, hands in portrait
cropped shoes, mannequins, flat lays, multiple people
sheer clothing, visible underwear, jewelry, logos, airbrushed skin
any exposed neck above front-panel crewneck
frontal right portrait; portrait must show obvious 30-degree head rotation
final_generation_instruction: ONE single 16:9 landscape composite image only: three side-by-side panels, separated by thin solid #d1d1d2 lines; solid uniform #504f50 background in every panel. Left: full-length front body in cream sweatshirt with no head and no neck above its collar. Center: full-length back body with hair seen only from behind. Right: large shoulder-up portrait of the same woman visibly turned 30 degrees into a three-quarter angle. Same clothes, no labels, no extra images.
